title: Achieving 19.6% efficiency in organic photovoltaics through guest-polymer assisted morphological fibrillization
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,3026-3035
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE03461A, Paper
Zhenye Li, Jiefeng Xie, Wenquan Wang, Zhiyuan Yang, Lixuan Kan, Ming Zhang, Zaiyu Wang, Wenyu Yang, Feng Peng, Wenkai Zhong, Lei Ying
A versatile guest-polymer-assisted morphological fibrillization strategy is introduced to substantially enhance the performance of organic photovoltaics.
